Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to what happened, but I'll go by the name on my policy.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was in the left-hand lane on the main road in League City, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic was
moving slowly because of the rain.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other car came over from the opposite direction and crossed into my lane. We hit nose to nose, but it wasn't a
hard impact. I'd guess we were going maybe fifteen miles an hour, if that.
Q: Did either vehicle leave the road or strike anything else?
A: No. Both cars stopped right where they hit. Nothing else was involved.
Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle on your own?
A: Yes, I walked around for a bit. My neck felt stiff almost right away, and by that evening my lower back was sore
too.
Q: Have you sought medical care since the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the next day. They said I had a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers
and told me to rest and do some stretching.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Some. Turning my head to the right is uncomfortable, and I notice the back soreness when I sit too long at my
desk.
Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?
A: Not that I can remember needing treatment for. I had a bit of stiffness now and then from sitting at work, but
nothing that stopped me.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm trying to keep up with my physical therapy appointments, and I'd appreciate it if this process moves
along as quickly as possible.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
